q: Local connectivity of the Mandelbrot set M is related to:
opts: The density of hyperbolic components being known to be false
The MLC conjecture (Mandelbrot set is locally connected), which if true would imply density of hyperbolicity
The set M being a fractal
The Julia set of every c ∈ M being locally connected
exp: MLC (Mandelbrot set is Locally Connected) is a central open conjecture. It would imply combinatorial description of M via external angles and would imply density of hyperbolic maps in the quadratic family—a major open problem.
